settings.heading: We Come to Your Office
settings.text:
Planning gifts for your employees, clients, partners, or an upcoming event? An Elma Vada representative can visit your office in the Dallas–Fort Worth area to discuss your project in person.

We’ll review your gifting needs, quantities, timeline, and personalization options, and bring samples for you to explore.

You’ll also receive a complimentary pen engraved with your name or company logo.
settings.fine_print: Office visits are arranged by appointment. Send us your office address and preferred availability, and we’ll confirm the location and meeting details with you.
settings.photo_note: Реальное фото Дарьи/места встречи и персонализированной ручки-образца.

settings.question: Can I order just one gift?
settings.answer: Yes. We handle orders from 1 to 5,000+ units. Tell us the product and quantity so we can confirm pricing and availability.

settings.question: Can I see a mockup or sample first?
settings.answer: Request a free custom mockup before ordering. Physical samples are available for qualifying projects. Ask about a sample. For an in-person review, request an office visit in Dallas–Fort Worth. Our representative comes to your office; the location and appointment details require confirmation.

settings.question: How quickly can you engrave my order?
settings.answer: Small orders can be ready in as little as 1 business day; up to 1,000 engraved pens can be produced in 1 business day. Turnaround time varies by product, quantity, design complexity, artwork approval, and inventory availability. Production timing does not include shipping.

settings.question: Can you visit our office?
settings.answer: Yes. An Elma Vada representative can visit your office in the Dallas–Fort Worth area to discuss your gifting project and show samples. Submit an office visit request with your address and preferred availability. We’ll confirm the location and appointment details with you.
